# 🎴 What is a Spanning Tree generated by a DFS traversal and what is its formal defini...

> [[00 - Flashcards MOC|🎴 Master MOC]] / [[00 - Trees & Heaps MOC|📁 Trees & Heaps MOC]]

---

### Q: What is a Spanning Tree generated by a DFS traversal and what is its formal definition? #card

?
A **spanning tree** is the subgraph formed only by the nodes of the graph and the edges followed during DFS that lead to unvisited nodes (_Tree Edges_).

**Formal definition:**
Given a connected undirected graph $G = (V, E)$, a spanning tree $T = (V, E')$ is a subgraph such that:

- $E' \subseteq E$ (consisting of the exploration edges);
- $T$ contains **all** nodes of $G$ (that is, the vertex set is exactly $V$);
- $T$ is a **tree** (i.e., it is a connected and acyclic graph with exactly $|V|-1$ edges).📌 Note:
  The spanning tree can be saved and used later to store parent-child relationships and to explore/reach the nodes of the graph more quickly.
